body: A Cessna 172 Skyhawk, registration N57BM, carrying a flight instructor and a student, overturned at John Wayne Airport (SNA) at around 2:38 p.m. local time on Saturday, November 7. The aircraft ended up upside down on a general aviation ramp operated by ACI Jet, a fixed-base operator, before a crane righted it and towed it away. Neither person on board was injured, and the extent of damage to the aircraft is not yet known.

Air traffic control audio indicates the Cessna may have been caught in the jet blast of a United Airlines Boeing 737. The pilot of another Cessna 172 taxiing behind N57BM reported that the plane had "just flipped over" and said they had been "blasted" by a United Boeing 737 jet blast. The aircraft's operator, Orange County Flight Center, also attributed the incident to jet blast, telling CBS Los Angeles the Cessna overturned following jet blast from either "a United or Southwest jet" taking off as the Cessna left the ramp toward the taxiway, though it could not confirm which aircraft was responsible.

An airport spokesperson attributed the incident to high winds. Early reports suggested it happened on a runway, but the spokesperson confirmed it occurred on the ramp. According to Boeing, the area exposed to jet blast can extend up to 400 feet behind large jets at breakaway thrust, and as much as 1,900 feet at takeoff thrust. Similar incidents have occurred before: on March 6 this year, a Cessna 182 taxiing at Flagstaff Pulliam Airport (FLG) was flipped by the jet blast of a parked SkyWest Bombardier CRJ700, reportedly injuring both occupants.
en.summary: A Cessna 172 carrying two people overturned at John Wayne Airport on Saturday afternoon; no one was injured. Air traffic control audio and the aircraft's operator point to jet blast from a departing jet, while the airport blames high winds.
en.title: Cessna 172 flips at John Wayne after reported United 737 jet blast; airport blames wind

body: 11月7日下午約2時38分（當地時間），一架塞斯納172（註冊編號N57BM）在約翰韋恩機場（SNA）翻覆，機上載有飛行教官與學員各1人。航機於ACI Jet營運的通用航空停機坪翻覆成機腹朝天，隨後由起重機扶正拖離；機上2人均未受傷，航機受損程度尚未明朗。
航管錄音顯示，事發可能與聯合航空一架波音737起飛時的噴流有關；當時跟在後方滑行的另一架塞斯納172機師通報，前機翻覆，並表示曾遭聯合航空波音737的噴流衝擊。航機營運商橙縣飛行中心（Orange County Flight Center）亦將事件歸因於噴流，並向CBS洛杉磯表示，塞斯納是在離開停機坪前往滑行道時，遭一架聯合或西南航空噴射機起飛時的噴流吹翻，但無法確認是哪一架飛機。
機場發言人則將事件歸因於強風；早期報導稱事發於跑道，但發言人確認事發地點為停機坪。波音資料指出，大型噴射機在脫離推力下的噴流影響範圍可達機後400呎，起飛推力時更可達1,900呎。今年3月6日，亞利桑那州旗桿市亦曾發生塞斯納182遭停放中的SkyWest CRJ700噴流吹翻的事件，機上2人據報受傷。
zh.summary: 一架載有2人的塞斯納172於11月7日下午在約翰韋恩機場停機坪翻覆，機上人員無人受傷；航管錄音與營運商指向鄰近噴射機起飛時的噴流，機場方面則稱強風所致，肇因尚未定論。
zh.title: 塞斯納172翻覆傳遭聯合737噴流波及，機場稱強風所致
